---
title: "About Me"
---

Welcome to my personal portfolio! Over the past several years I've grown from a student of statistics into someone eager to apply data science in the real world. My projects reflect the technical skills I have gained such as visualizations or machine learning in R, as well as personal interests that keep me motivated, like helping solve Manchester Uniteds problems. 

Outside of coding and analysis, I stay grounded by watching sports, playing soccer, and enjoying time with friends. These experiences often fuel my curiosity and inspire the kinds of data questions I like to explore. 

This site is both a portfolio as well as a snapshot of my journey. I hope you find something here that sparks your interest!
